topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
subtopic: Reading Fee Disclosures and Account Statements
source_evidence: These fees may not always be obvious to you from your account statement or confirmation statement.
question: Misconception: If a fee does not appear clearly on my account statement, I wasn’t charged it.
answer: A fee may not be obvious on your statement or confirmation. Check the fee schedule or other fee disclosures, and ask your investment professional to explain any charges you do not understand.
